description.value: Head of a house holding two named channels and the ground between them, and the coast's most quoted authority on why a channel can be owned. She declines to discuss the weir keepers' objection on the grounds that it was answered before she was born and that repeating an answer weakens it. She has stood still for six hours at a stretch in the survey's presence and would not stand still for a photograph, which she considers a different kind of standing.

formOfAddress: by house name; personal names are used only within the house
